artifacts.description: feat(kernel): asymmetric chamfer by two distances or distance and angle

acceptance_criteria: Public `EdgeOnFace { edge: SubShape, face: SubShape }`, `ChamferSize::{TwoDistances { d1, d2 }, DistanceAngle { distance, angle }}`, and `Kernel::chamfer_asymmetric(&self, s, edges: &[EdgeOnFace], size: ChamferSize) -> Result<Self::Shape, KernelError>`, documented with the convention above and implemented for `OcctKernel`. An identical `EdgeOnFace` listed twice counts once. New shim code is `noexcept` and catches C++ exceptions. Every new `unsafe` call is in `ffi` with a SAFETY comment.

Box tests on `make_box((0,0,0),(10,20,30))` (volume 6000). Volumes within 1e-6 relative: two distances (2, 4) over 24 edge/face cases; distance-angle (2, π/6) over 24 cases; π/4 and d1 = d2 = 2 equal `chamfer(…, 2.0)`; placement on the top/front edge for both reference faces; overall bounding box unchanged.

Errors, each with a test and never a panic, all `InvalidInput` and checked before anything reaches OCCT: d1, d2 or distance ≤ 0 or not finite; angle not finite or not strictly between 0 and π/2; an empty list; an `edge` whose kind isn't `Edge` or a `face` whose kind isn't `Face`; an index out of range; a face that isn't adjacent to its edge; the same edge listed twice with different faces.
A size OCCT can't build returns an `Err` (not `Ok`, not a panic): TwoDistances (2, 35) on each of the 24 edge/face pairs. The input shape is still usable afterwards (volume 6000).
No new dependencies. `swx-kernel` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass, and so do the CI `swx-kernel (occt)` job commands.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
